title: JPL Farside Seismic Suite mission page
quote_lifetime: It will operate for at least 4½ months, providing a long-lived seismic experiment capable of answering key scientific questions.
quote_cube: Using a cube-within-a-cube design, FSS is packaged as a self-sufficient payload, with independent power, communications, and thermal control to enable survival through the Moon's frigid nights and searing days.
note: Launch 2027 still listed after CP-12 termination. No W/Wh. Site temperature not printed. PALETTE toolbox not mixed.
